description: We are NASA Knights, competing in the Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data challenge at the Jaffna Local Event.
summary: FieldShift helps farmers and agricultural extension workers compare crop-rotation ideas using NASA climate history, field notes, and farmer priorities. It analyzes ten complete years of NASA POWER monthly temperature and rainfall at a selected farm coordinate, plots each completed Yala or Maha season so users can inspect year-by-year variability, and ranks transparent crop-rotation concepts by water access, soil texture, and the farmer’s chosen goal (water conservation, soil building, or income options). An independent NASA GPM IMERG satellite rainfall estimate is shown separately as a cross-check when available. Farmers can also download a portable, printable Field Decision Card to support extension conversations. FieldShift is an explainable planning prototype, not a yield forecast or substitute for local agricultural advice.
details:
What It Does & How It Works

Farmers often have to weigh water availability, soil conditions, crop sequence, and household priorities at the same time. FieldShift turns those inputs into an explainable comparison for farmers and agricultural extension workers:

1. Context Input: A user enters farm coordinates (starting with Jaffna Peninsula, Sri Lanka, 9.66° N, 80.02° E, or any custom coordinates), soil texture, approximate pH, current main crop, water access, planning season (Yala: March–August; Maha: September–February), and top priority (water conservation, soil building, or income options).

2. NASA Climate Analysis: The app requests monthly 2-meter air temperature (T2M) and corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR) from the NASA POWER Agroclimatology Monthly Point API for the previous ten complete calendar years. It converts monthly mean precipitation from mm/day into monthly and seasonal totals and highlights seasons below 75% of that season’s historical median rainfall.

3. Independent Satellite Cross-Check: When available, FieldShift also queries NASA POWER’s Hydrology community API for IMERG_PRECTOT (NASA GPM IMERG precipitation) and compares matched seasonal averages separately without silently blending the two products. If NASA services are unreachable, the app falls back to clearly labeled sample data.

4. Deterministic Ranking & Field Decision Card: A transparent 1–100 heuristic scores and ranks crop-rotation concepts based on dry-season frequency, water access, soil texture, and farmer priority, showing plain-language reasons and caveats alongside the current crop baseline. Users can export a one-click printable/shareable HTML/PDF Field Decision Card for extension consultations.

Benefits & Intended Impact

- Bridges the gap between gridded NASA Earth observation data and practical, seasonal farm rotation conversations.

- Gives smallholder farmers and extension officers an accessible, offline-resilient, and printable decision aid without requiring data-science expertise.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used

- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SVG data visualizations

- Build & Tooling: Vite, Node.js, tsx (19-check automated verification test suite)

- Data APIs: NASA POWER Temporal Monthly Point API (Agroclimatology & Hydrology / GPM IMERG)

Creativity & Factors Considered

- Makes 10-year seasonal variability visible year-by-year rather than hiding it behind a single average.

- Keeps independent rainfall products (MERRA-2/Agroclimatology vs. GPM IMERG) distinct for scientific transparency.

- Explicitly frames outputs as an explainable planning aid rather than an unverified yield or weather forecast.

AI / Super Intelligence (SI) Disclosure

AI coding assistants (OpenAI Codex / LLM tools) assisted with software code, research, draft scoring logic and crop-trait assumptions, and project-description text. The team reviewed, tested, and edited the implementation. NASA data is fetched directly from NASA POWER and was not generated or modified by AI. No AI-generated images, videos, audio, NASA logos, flags, or mission identifiers are included.
